Live: https://medilinda.vercel.app · Code: https://github.com/kraigochieng/medilinda

Live: https://ecommerce-sales-analysis.streamlit.app/ · Code: https://github.com/kraigochieng/ecommerce-sales-analysis
- [YC Elevator Pitch Doctor](https://yc-elevator-pitch-doctor.onrender.com): Enabling startup founders to craft elevator pitches based on top 75+ YC companies via an agent. Live: https://yc-elevator-pitch-doctor.onrender.com · Code: https://github.com/kraigochieng/yc-elevator-pitch-doctor
- [ElevenLabs Text-To-Speech Chunker](https://elevenlabs-tts-chunker.vercel.app/): A FastAPI wrapper around the ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech API that transparently handles text longer than ElevenLabs' 10,000-character limit per request. Send it text of any length; it chunks, synthesizes each chunk, and returns one merged mp3. Live: https://elevenlabs-tts-chunker.vercel.app/ · Code: https://github.com/kraigochieng/elevenlabs-tts-chunker
